payment_action_required.subject: Payment Action Required - Complete Your Payment for {tenantName}
payment_action_required.title: Payment Action Required
payment_action_required.body: Your payment requires additional verification (e.g. 3D Secure). Please complete the payment to avoid service interruption.

day0.subject: Payment Failed - Action Required for {tenantName}
day0.title: Payment Failed - Immediate Action Required
day0.payment_failed: Your recent payment attempt has failed and requires immediate attention.
day0.action_required: Please update your payment method to avoid service interruption. Your invoice is available below:
day0.consequences: If payment is not received within 7 days, your service may be suspended to prevent additional charges.

day3.subject: Payment Reminder - {tenantName}
day3.title: Payment Reminder - Urgent Action Required
day3.reminder: This is a reminder that your payment is still outstanding.
day3.urgency: Please resolve this payment issue as soon as possible to avoid service interruption.
day3.consequences: If payment is not received within 2 days, your service will be suspended.

day5.subject: Final Notice - Service Suspension Imminent for {tenantName}
day5.title: Final Notice - Service Suspension Imminent
day5.final_notice: This is your final notice regarding the outstanding payment.
day5.last_chance: This is your last opportunity to resolve this payment issue before service suspension.
day5.consequences: If payment is not received immediately, your service will be suspended within 24 hours.

common.questions: If you have any questions, please contact our support team at {supportEmail}.
